en-US.longDescription: RelayPony for the desktop sends and receives files between your computer and your phones, encrypted end to end with the age protocol. Pairs by QR code with the RelayPony iOS and Android apps. No server, no cloud, no account.
en-US.name: RelayPony
en-US.releaseNotes:
Extends the Linux file-picker fix to the .deb and the portable tarball. The AppImage was fixed in 2.2.0 and the AUR package shortly after, but the .deb and tarball kept shipping the unwrapped launcher; this build wraps them too. If you use the AppImage or the AUR package, nothing here changes for you.

Upgrading: nothing to do beyond installing the new build. Identities, pairings, and the transfer format are unchanged.

zh-CN.description: 端到端加密的设备间直接文件传输。
zh-CN.longDescription: RelayPony 桌面版可在电脑与手机之间收发文件，全程使用 age 协议端到端加密，通过二维码与 RelayPony iOS 和 Android 应用配对。无需服务器、无需云端、无需账号。
